final: WITH actor_films AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) as film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_records FROM film_actor), actor_proportions AS (SELECT af.actor_id, af.film_count, CAST(af.film_count AS DECIMAL(10,6)) / CAST(t.total_records AS DECIMAL(10,6)) as proportion FROM actor_films af CROSS JOIN totals t), average_proportion AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_prop FROM actor_proportions) SELECT ap.actor_id, ap.film_count, ap.proportion, ap.proportion - avp.avg_prop as difference_from_avg FROM actor_proportions ap CROSS JOIN average_proportion avp ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
